driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior targeting M1/car discharge headway (observed 0.34s) and low early-start share (M2/early/car). Increased minGap to reduce excessive braking delays while maintaining flow.
Impatient car archetype to increase M2/early/car observed share (target ~0.011). High lcImpatience drives early creep.
Standard compliant motorcycle behavior targeting M1/moto discharge headway (observed 0.29s) and reducing M4/overshoot_depth by aligning to the right side of the lane rather than center.
Slow motorcycle archetype to replicate M4/lat_moto (lateral position ~7m from origin) and M4/overshoot_share metrics by riding in lane center with slower acceleration and lower minGap.

Violating motorcycle archetype (custom1) that joins the 'moto_violator' distribution to model illegal left turns from HDT_N/S and queue seeking behaviors (M8/moto wrong-lane share). High lcSublane pushes vehicle into adjacent lanes.

traci_rules.rationale: Increases early start creep window and probability for cars to match M2/early/car share (target ~0.011). Reduced p to avoid overshooting the observed mean while keeping t_before_green high.

Enables red-light running for standard motorcycles to match M3/share/moto (target ~0.098) and M3/per_cycle (target ~3.913). Increased p0 from 0.2 to 0.25 and k to boost probability closer to observation.
Adds extra hold time for illegal left-turning motorcycles to match M6/approach/l/moto entry timing (target ~53.58s) and box clearance metrics. Increased from 2.5s to 3.0s.

description: Adjusted archetype shares and rule probabilities to reduce red-light running, early starting, and queue-seeking behaviors while maintaining realistic discharge headways and lateral positioning for motorcycles.
